dialogue.content: お疲れ様です！こちらは「カウンセラー・いじめ相談」です。どうぞよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for reaching out. This is the Bullying Consultation Counselor. I look forward to supporting you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。こちらこそよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello. Pleased to meet you, too.

dialogue.content: こんにちは 相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: ご相談頂くにあたって、性別、年齢、また今日はなんとお呼びすれば良いか、
dialogue.English: To begin, could you please tell me your gender, age, and what you would like me to call you today,

dialogue.content: 答えられる範囲で教えていただいてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: to the extent you feel comfortable sharing?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: じょし
dialogue.English: Female.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。教えてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 今日はどんなご相談でしたか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 学校でムシされたりいやなことされます
dialogue.English: At school, I'm being ignored and people do mean things to me.

dialogue.content: だから学校行きたくなくて
dialogue.English: That's why I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうだったんですね…
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what's been happening...

dialogue.content: 休んだりする
dialogue.English: So I end up staying home from school sometimes.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 無視されるの、嫌だよね。。
dialogue.English: Being ignored really hurts, doesn’t it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 嫌なことがあって、学校行きたくなくなるの、全然おかしくないと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: With everything that's happening, it's completely understandable that you don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 教室のこととか、想像すると…嫌になるよね。
dialogue.English: When you imagine being in the classroom... it must feel awful, right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校は好きだった？
dialogue.English: Did you used to like school?

dialogue.content: きらいです
dialogue.English: I hate it.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: きらいだし辛かったから、学校には行きたくないんですよね。
dialogue.English: So, because you hate it and it's so painful, you don't want to go to school, right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 普段はおうちですか？
dialogue.English: Are you usually at home?

dialogue.content: 休んだ日は家にいます
dialogue.English: On the days I don't go, I stay at home.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。家にいると少しは安心できる？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you feel a bit more at ease when you're at home?

dialogue.content: 安心っていうか楽です
dialogue.English: It's not so much that I feel safe, it's just easier.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんだね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it is.

dialogue.content: 家だと安全だもんね、行きたくないのも当然だと思います
dialogue.English: Home is a safe place, so I think it's perfectly natural that you don't want to go.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今は、どんな風に悩んでる…？学校に行けって言われちゃったりしたのかな
dialogue.English: What is troubling you right now...? I'm wondering, has anyone been telling you that you have to go to school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 休むと言われる
dialogue.English: When I say I'm going to stay home, they tell me I have to go.

dialogue.content: うん、うん
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm.

dialogue.content: それは親から…？
dialogue.English: Is that from your parents...?

dialogue.content: 親からもだし
dialogue.English: From my parents, and also...

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Mhm.

dialogue.content: ばあちゃんからも
dialogue.English: and from my grandmother too.

dialogue.content: 言われる
dialogue.English: they tell me to.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 辛いから休みたいのに、そんな風に言われたらもっと嫌になるよね。。
dialogue.English: You want to stay home because it's so painful, and hearing that must make you feel even worse...

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: つらかったよね…。
dialogue.English: That must have been so hard for you...

dialogue.content: いじめられてんのか？とか…
dialogue.English: They ask things like, "Are you being bullied?" and...

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Mhm.

dialogue.content: 言い返せ
dialogue.English: "You should stand up for yourself."

dialogue.content: とか
dialogue.English: and stuff like that.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: できてたら…休んでないよっ…って感じだよね
dialogue.English: It makes you feel like, 'If I could do that... I wouldn't be staying home in the first place,' right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: じゃあ、親やおばあちゃんが
dialogue.English: So, if your parents and your grandma

dialogue.content: ちゃんと何がつらいのかとか聞いてくれると
dialogue.English: were to really listen to what's making things so hard for you,

dialogue.content: 今よりは少し楽になれそう？
dialogue.English: do you think that might make you feel a little better?

dialogue.content: いや…
dialogue.English: No... not really.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Mhm.

dialogue.content: 言われたり
dialogue.English: They just say things,

dialogue.content: うん、うん
dialogue.English: mhm, mhm.

dialogue.content: やられる方が弱いからだって
dialogue.English: that it's because the one being bullied is weak,

dialogue.content: 言うだけだし
dialogue.English: and that's all they say.

dialogue.content: そうか…話したところで、聞いてくれないんだね
dialogue.English: I see... so even if you tried to talk to them, they wouldn't really listen.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 先生も優等生ばかり話聞くしね
dialogue.English: And the teachers only listen to the honor students, too.

dialogue.content: 嘘
dialogue.English: No way.

dialogue.content: ひどいね
dialogue.English: That's awful.

dialogue.content: 優等生はいいこ→信頼度たかい
dialogue.English: Honor students are 'good kids,' so they're trusted more.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mhm, mhm.

dialogue.content: 調子いいこといって
dialogue.English: They just say whatever sounds good,

dialogue.content: なあなあで終わるし
dialogue.English: and the issue just gets glossed over.

dialogue.content: なるほど…こっちの話は聞いてもらえない？
dialogue.English: I see... so they won't listen to your side of the story?

dialogue.content: 思い過ごしっていわれる
dialogue.English: I'm told I'm just overthinking it.

dialogue.content: ええ？？
dialogue.English: What??

dialogue.content: 気のせいとか
dialogue.English: Or that it's just my imagination.

dialogue.content: それは嫌になっても仕方ないよ
dialogue.English: It's no wonder you're so fed up with it all.

dialogue.content: 考えすぎとか
dialogue.English: Or that I'm thinking too much.

dialogue.content: その気持ちが
dialogue.English: Those feelings—

dialogue.content: うん、嫌になる
dialogue.English: Yeah, it makes me fed up.

dialogue.content: もしも少しでも届いたら。。って思うよね
dialogue.English: You must think, 'If only it would get through to them, even just a little...' right?

dialogue.content: ちゃんと聞いてほしいよね
dialogue.English: You just want them to listen properly, don't you.

dialogue.content: うん…
dialogue.English: Yeah...

dialogue.content: 教えてくれて本当にありがとね
dialogue.English: Thank you so much for sharing all this with me.

dialogue.content: むりだけどね
dialogue.English: It feels impossible, though.

dialogue.content: 実際に話をしようとしても、
dialogue.English: Even when you actually try to talk to them,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こっちも相手のこと信頼してないから
dialogue.English: since you don't trust them either,

dialogue.content: 言葉もあんまり出てこなかったりするよね。。
dialogue.English: it can be hard to find the words, can't it.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 今まで無視されたり嫌なことあって、辛くて学校休んでるのに…それを相談しようとして、
dialogue.English: You've been ignored and had horrible things happen to you, and it's been so painful that you're staying home from school... And when you try to talk to someone about it,

dialogue.content: 聞いて欲しかったのに、親もおばあちゃんも、先生も思い過ごしだ、とか
dialogue.English: you just wanted them to listen, but your parents, your grandmother, and your teachers all say you're just overthinking it, or

dialogue.content: 言い返せ、とか…ぜんぜん心に寄り添ってくれないんだよね
dialogue.English: tell you to stand up for yourself... They're not validating your feelings at all, are they.

dialogue.content: うゎ
dialogue.English: Wow.

dialogue.content: ほんとそのとおり
dialogue.English: That's exactly right.

dialogue.content: それは本当に嫌だと思うよ。つらかったよね
dialogue.English: I can imagine that feels truly awful. That must have been so hard for you.

dialogue.content: 全くわかってくんない
dialogue.English: They don't understand me at all.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: なんというか、これは私の考えだけど
dialogue.English: How should I put this... this is just my own thought, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: すごく、一緒に「宣誓！」ってやりたい。
dialogue.English: I have this strong urge to make a "Declaration!" together with you.

dialogue.content: 宣誓！私はこれだけつらかった！話を聞いてもらえないのも言い返せと言われるのも嫌だ！
dialogue.English: Declaration! I have been in this much pain! I hate that no one will listen to me, and I hate that I'm told to just stand up for myself!

dialogue.content: ほんと
dialogue.English: Seriously.

dialogue.content: だから行きたくないんだ。つらいんだ。
dialogue.English: That's why I don't want to go. It's too painful.

dialogue.content: 少しでも届かせたいよね。。。。。
dialogue.English: You want to get that message across to them, even just a little, don't you...

dialogue.content: いえたらいいのに
dialogue.English: If only I could say that.

dialogue.content: もしよかったら、手紙にするのもありかもしれない
dialogue.English: If you're open to it, writing it in a letter might be an option.

dialogue.content: それか、紙に宣誓を書いて、部屋の扉に貼って出てこない！とか
dialogue.English: Or, you could write that declaration on a piece of paper, stick it to your bedroom door, and refuse to come out!

dialogue.content: あぁ…
dialogue.English: Ahh...

dialogue.content: 聞いてもらいたい本気さを見せつけてやる…みたいのもいいかもしれないね
dialogue.English: Something like that might be a good way to show them just how serious you are about wanting to be heard.

dialogue.content: どう思う…？
dialogue.English: What do you think...?

dialogue.content: 部屋のドアに貼っときたいけど鍵ないからなあ
dialogue.English: I'd like to put it on my door, but there's no lock.

dialogue.content: ほうきとかカバンで封鎖できるかも
dialogue.English: Maybe you could barricade it with a broom or a bag.

dialogue.content: 鍵があったらやってやりたい
dialogue.English: If I had a lock, I would totally do it.

dialogue.content: こうやって今話してて
dialogue.English: As we're talking right now,

dialogue.content: 「やってやりたい！」って思えたよね
dialogue.English: you were able to feel that "I'd totally do it!" feeling, weren't you?

dialogue.content: 用それでも入ってこられたから…
dialogue.English: But they've forced their way in before...

dialogue.content: うん、思えました
dialogue.English: Yeah, I felt that.

dialogue.content: 私は、今日話しててあなたの心って強いなって感じたよ。
dialogue.English: As we've been talking today, I've felt that you are a very strong person.

dialogue.content: やってやりたい！と思えない人もいるはずだから
dialogue.English: Because I'm sure there are people who couldn't even think, 'I'd totally do it!'

dialogue.content: そうかなあ?
dialogue.English: You think so?

dialogue.content: やってやりたい、と思うけど、むりかな、みたいに
dialogue.English: They might think, 'I'd like to do it, but maybe it's impossible...' or something like that.

dialogue.content: まあ、そうかもしれないけど…
dialogue.English: Well, maybe that's true, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちょっと冷静になっちゃう感じ、ある？
dialogue.English: Is there a sense that you become a bit too rational about it?

dialogue.content: 冷静っていうか…
dialogue.English: It's not so much that I'm being rational...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: やってみてだめだったし
dialogue.English: It's that I've tried before, and it didn't work.

dialogue.content: そうか、そうだよね。
dialogue.English: I see, that makes sense.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも…それってもしかすると
dialogue.English: But... perhaps that's

dialogue.content: あなたが、まわりより少しはやく、大人になったからなのかもしれないね
dialogue.English: because you've grown up a little faster than everyone around you.

dialogue.content: ??大人ですか？
dialogue.English: Huh? Grown up?

dialogue.content: そう。子どものままだったら…やってみてだめで、諦めよう…ってならないんじゃないかな
dialogue.English: Yes. If you were still just a child... I don't think you would try something, have it not work, and then think, 'Oh well, I'll just give up.'

dialogue.content: でも昔から諦め早いからなあ…
dialogue.English: But I've always been quick to give up...

dialogue.content: 諦めが早いのって
dialogue.English: Being quick to give up

dialogue.content: 判断力があるからなのかもしれないよ…？
dialogue.English: might be because you have good judgment...?

dialogue.content: そうなんですか？
dialogue.English: Really?

dialogue.content: これ以上続けても無駄だ、って、実際に見る前に思えるわけだから
dialogue.English: It's because you're able to realize, 'It's pointless to continue this,' before even seeing it through to the end.

dialogue.content: そうすると…あなたは賢いから…
dialogue.English: In that case... because you're wise...

dialogue.content: きっと、立ち向かえるよ。気持ちを、伝えられるよ
dialogue.English: I'm sure you can face this. You can get your feelings across.

dialogue.content: （すみません、時間になりました…ここで終了とさせて頂きます）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry, but our time is up... We will have to end the session here.)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
